description: This file defines an abstract PHP class `AbstractVueController` within the `OrangeHRM` Human Resource Management system. It manages rendering Vue.js components with templating via Twig, handles HTTP requests and responses, and provides a base for other Vue controllers by offering methods for initialization, pre- and post-render processing, and error handling.

classes.name: AbstractVueController
classes.description: An abstract base class for Vue.js integrated controllers in the OrangeHRM system, providing rendering, request handling, and error handling functionalities.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the HTTP request, possibly invoking preRender, render, and postRender, and returns an HTTP response.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the Twig environment used for rendering templates.

methods.name: setTwig
methods.description: Sets the Twig environment for template rendering.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the current template filename used for rendering.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template filename used for rendering.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Assigns the Vue component associated with this controller, throwing an exception if already handled.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the Vue component associated with this controller.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the AttributeBag object used to store context variables for rendering.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response object and marks the controller as handled.

methods.name: isHandled
methods.description: Checks if the request has been fully handled.

methods.name: setHandled
methods.description: Marks whether the controller has completed processing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Optional initialization method for subclasses, invoked during construction.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook for pre-render processing before rendering the response.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the assigned component with Twig into a string.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Hook for post-render processing after rendering the content.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles bad request scenarios by setting a default 'bad-request' component.
